moments.author: NBA
moments.quote: Cooper Flagg DELIVERED in the clutch for Dallas — blocked the 3 then hit the layup
moments.why: A historic 19‑year‑old performance (29pts, 11ast, 6reb, 5stl, 3blk) that’s redefining rookie expectations and lighting up the NBA chatter.

moments.author: Mavs PR
moments.quote: Flagg became just the 2nd player since blocks were recorded to notch that stat line (James Harden)
moments.why: Historic rarity—only James Harden has matched that all‑stat-line since tracking began.

moments.author: Kevin O'Connor
moments.quote: That was an MVP type of performance by Cooper Flagg
moments.why: Award buzz instantly ignited from a breakout all‑around effort.

moments.author: AP (Tim Reynolds)
moments.quote: Cooper Flagg had 29 points, 11 assists, blocked the shot that sealed it
moments.why: AP’s account highlights the clutch defensive play that made the performance unforgettable.
